- [USER] User expressed interest in trying local produce while traveling and asked for recommendations for farmers' markets in Guangzhou.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Baijia Wholesale Market is one of the largest wholesale markets in Guangzhou, specializing in local and imported fruits, vegetables, and meats.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Litchi Bay Market is located near the Zhujiang River and specializes in locally grown fruits like lychees, mangoes, and dragon fruit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fangcun Farmers' Market is one of the oldest and most popular farmers' markets in Guangzhou, offering local fruits, vegetables, herbs, spices, fresh seafood, and meat.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wushan Organic Farmers' Market is located in Tianhe District and specializes in organic produce grown by local farmers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Guangzhou Daily Fresh Market, also known as "Xinjiao Farm Market," is one of the largest fresh markets in Guangzhou, offering a wide range of fresh produce, meat, and seafood.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is important to research the opening hours and location of these markets beforehand as they may vary.
